Inducers of CYP3A4 and P-gp may decrease sirolimus concentrations whereas inhibitors of CYP3A4 and P-gp may increase sirolimus concentrations. Avoid concomitant use with strong
contraindications: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Sirolimus is contraindicated in patients with a hypersensitivity to sirolimus [ see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.4 ) ]. Hypersensitivity to sirolimus ( 4 ).
